newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs higher, upside capped by Sakakibara rumour.
newsitem.headline: JGBs higher, upside capped by Sakakibara rumour.

text.p: Cash and futures JGBs were higher in mid-morning trade on Thursday, but their upside was capped by widespread talk that an influential Finance Ministry official may indicate a rate rise today, traders said.

Market talk that Eisuke Sakakibara, vice Finance Minister for International Affairs may indicate an increase in Japanese interest rates kept JGBs from extending gains in spite of the decisively bullish sentiment in bonds, traders said.
Officials at the Ministry of Finance said Sakakibara is on holiday until August 4.
"We've received a lot of queries this morning from overseas traders on Sakakibara. They may be wary of buying JGBs as the yield is approaching record low levels," said a European bank trader.
The yield of the benchmark 182nd 10-year JGB was at 2.110 percent at 0140 GMT, down from Wednesday's 2.125 percent. Its record low yield was 2.0750 percent set on April 8.
The key September JGB futures contract was at 126.42, up from Thursday's 126.21.
